actions: Keep real splitter/assembler boundaries, exact UTF8/frame/part/aggregate caps, order, distinct IDs, incomplete sets, tombstones, discard and teardown. Drop fixed count inventory and redundant approximate-ceiling/parity/controls setup.
Fix tombstone entire-payload fixture and missing-final-frame fallbacks. Add independent TextEncoder ceiling measurements.

For direct assembler pressure, generate individually reader-accepted frames and assert that prerequisite; do not model impossible raw chunk=wholeframecap input. Preserve deliberate malformed complete JSON and invalid-response payloads as adversarial input.

Force a surrogate split using smaller partitions of an actual splitter chunk, reindex part counts and assert every serialized frame is accepted; this pressures join-byte accounting without constructing unsendable multi-megabyte parts.
